am_rx_i2s.title: AM receiver with I2S audio
am_rx_i2s.desc: An AM receiver for a complex ADC at 1.92 MS/s: channel selection with a frequency-translating FIR, a second filter to 48 kS/s, envelope detection, DC removal and AGC; the audio goes to an I2S DAC (both channels) and the CPU reads the signal level from a probe.

wbfm_rx_i2s.title: Wideband FM receiver with I2S audio
wbfm_rx_i2s.desc: A broadcast FM receiver built from primitive blocks: channel filter to 480 kS/s, quadrature demodulator, 75 us de-emphasis, audio filter and decimation to 48 kS/s, volume and an I2S DAC.

qpsk_tx_spi.title: QPSK transmitter to a dual SPI DAC
qpsk_tx_spi.desc: A QPSK modulator: a PRBS feeds pairs of bits to the constellation mapper, a root-raised-cosine interpolator shapes the symbols (4 samples per symbol), and a dual 12-bit SPI DAC (I on channel A, Q on channel B) plays them at 250 kS/s.

bpsk_rx_uart.title: BPSK receiver with a UART data output
bpsk_rx_uart.desc: A BPSK receiver for a complex ADC at 1 MS/s and 125 kbit/s: root-raised-cosine matched filter, AGC, Costas loop for the carrier, one sample per symbol, slicer, and bytes out on a UART at 921600 Bd. The symbol clock is assumed known (a fixed phase), as in a lab link.

spectrum_dma.title: Spectrum analyser with DMA
spectrum_dma.desc: A 256-point spectrum analyser: one frame in eight of the ADC stream goes through a windowed FFT and a magnitude-squared stage, and a DMA channel writes the power spectra into a ring of buffers in RAM, one frame per buffer, without the CPU.

audio_eq_i2s.title: Stereo three-band equaliser between I2S codecs
audio_eq_i2s.desc: A stereo three-band equaliser: the codec ADC delivers left and right as one complex stream, two one-pole low-pass filters split it into bass, mid and treble, each band has a runtime gain, and the sum goes to the codec DAC. Both I2S ports are masters at 48 kHz.

dtmf_gen.title: DTMF generator on a sigma-delta pin and I2S
dtmf_gen.desc: A DTMF tone generator: two oscillators with runtime frequencies (the row and column tones of a key) are summed and scaled, then played on a single pin as a second-order sigma-delta bit stream (an RC filter makes it analogue) and on an I2S DAC.

ddc_cic_dma.title: Digital down-converter with CIC and DMA
ddc_cic_dma.desc: A digital down-converter for an ADC at 27 MS/s: a rotator moves the channel to 0 Hz, a four-stage CIC decimates by 32, a compensating FIR by 2 more, and a DMA channel writes the 421.875 kS/s baseband into a ring buffer in RAM. A probe tracks the channel power.

level_meter_spi.title: Level meter: SPI ADC, LED and UART log
level_meter_spi.desc: An audio level meter: a 12-bit SPI ADC samples at 200 kS/s, DC is removed, the rectified signal is averaged over 1 ms and read 1000 times per second. The level drives an alarm LED through a threshold with hysteresis, is logged as text on a UART and is readable from a probe.

siggen_spi_dac.title: Two-channel signal generator
siggen_spi_dac.desc: A signal generator: a quadrature oscillator with runtime frequency and level drives a dual SPI DAC (sine and cosine on channels A and B) at 100 kS/s, and a sawtooth drives a PWM pin.
